messages:
nina: quick design review of canary snapshot card. I trimmed metadata and moved timestamp to the bottom to reduce visual clutter. wondering about SR/cursor flow.

raju: visually cleaner. SR concern: order matters. suggest commit message -> sha -> author -> timestamp so context comes first.

olivia: +1. Also shorten rollback CTA from 'Revert to this version' to 'Rollback' for mobile.

ben: agree. Make the snapshot card one focusable container with internal roving tabindex for actions (preview/rollback) so keyboard users don't tab through every meta item.

raju: add aria-live="polite" for canary promotion updates and announce failures.

a11y-bot: tip: if you change DOM order for SR, preserve visual layout with CSS order; avoid hiding SR content with display:none.

nina: noted. I'll keep DOM order SR-friendly and use flex order for visuals. Will add aria-describedby to Rollback: 'Creates a new deployment pinned to this version.'

olivia: also increase collapse handle hit target in timeline to 24px and left-align label for clear keyboard focus.

ben: add e2e: focus snapshot, Enter Rollback, expect modal 'Confirm rollback' with focus trap.

nina: will update Figma and push copy. tagging @raju @olivia for quick QA by EOD. :thumbsup:
